I'm a Statistics M.A. student at UC Berkeley with five years of industry experience at McKinsey and Deloitte. My work focuses on rigorous statistical modeling and decision-focused analytics.

Before Berkeley, I built large-scale ETL pipelines, data warehouse architectures, and analytics products serving enterprise clients in the US. I returned to graduate school to build the statistical foundations needed to make the shift from data engineering into data science.

**Open to data science roles starting May 2026.** [Get in touch](mailto:ricardoperez@berkeley.edu)
